itens.original: We reduce where necessary and create where it matters. Less frills, more substance. By striving for perfection in simplicity, we unfold creative visions. Embracing a minimal approach, we meticulously distill ideas to their essence. This is Reduce Studios.

itens.chave: t:Welcome to Reduce® Studio, nestled in the middle picturesque#mvpf85
itens.original: Welcome to Reduce® Studio, nestled in the middle picturesque Engiadina, where our name says it all. Surrounded by breathtaking landscapes, we embody simplicity in design. Our team, inspired by the natural beauty that envelopes us, seamlessly merges Swiss precision with creative finesse. At Simplify Studio, our name is our promise. Crafting visually striking designs by simplifying the complex.

itens.original: Welcome on a journey through Vitra’s minimalist oasis. Set against the backdrop of a barren desert, our latest campaign transforms the stark landscape into a canvas for inspiring chair designs. In this brief encounter, each chair becomes a sculptural marvel, embodying elegance and functionality amidst the simplicity of the desert. Experience the magic of Vitra’s new catalogue and editorial designs.

itens.original: We created the Stüssy surfscape, where landscapes transform into textures. Our latest campaign immerses you in a world where the horizon blends seamlessly with the essence of surf culture. Against this vast canvas, the surfboard becomes a symbol of boundless exploration, disappearing into the expansive unknown. Experience the Stüssy surf magic, where landscapes become a canvas.

itens.original: Discover the world of Nike, where geometry takes center stage in a symphony of precision and style. Our latest campaign transforms the basketball court into a visual masterpiece, where every hoop becomes a graphic expression of symmetry and form. Witness the fusion of athleticism and artistry as the basketball net evolves into a captivating design. Experience the Nike journey with Reduce Studios.

itens.original: We created an imagery for Aesop, where the products take center stage in a fresh perspective on still life. We’ve turned tranquility into an art form, with foam transcending its functional role to become a creative medium. Watch as bubbles and lather transform everyday scenes into new captivating compositions. Aesop invites you to explore this innovative intersection of simplicity and minimalism.

itens.original: Our latest design venture presents boards stripped of traditional graphics, embracing the allure of all black. Experience the purity of form and function as these sleek, monochromatic boards redefine minimalism on the slopes. Nitro invites you to embrace the essence of snowboarding with a design philosophy that is as straightforward and powerful as the mountains themselves. Unleash the thrill of the ride.

itens.original: For Prince, we brought simplicity back to the game. Our latest campaign introduces clean and straightforward graphic visuals, transforming the court into a canvas of minimalist design. Experience the elegance of uncomplicated graphics that echo the precision of your game. Prince Tennis invites you to rediscover the beauty of simplicity, both in your play and in the visual language of the court.
